title: Dataobject realizes Dataobject
description: The concrete data structure gives a tangible implementation of an abstract or contract-level data definition, such as a DTO class implementing a shared interface or type contract, or a generated class materializing a schema-defined message type.
x-dr-evidence: The concrete class or struct declares that it implements the abstract type (for example `implements`, a TypeScript `satisfies` or structural conformance check), or a code generator config such as OpenAPI, protobuf or Avro shows the class produced from the abstract schema definition.
